'''Dharus' Buccaneers''' was a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] group lead by renowned [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dharus]]. They were affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and carried out attacks of piracy against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] along the [[Leisure Corridor]].<ref name="P&P" />

==Organization==
The Buccaneers had 97 members and operated three [[Starship/Legends|starships]], the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] ''[[Dark Revenge]]'' and two [[Corsair-class cruiser|''Corsair''-class cruisers]], the ''[[Red Lancer]]'' and the ''[[Blue Queen]]''.<ref name="P&P" />
